status: PRE-REGISTERED BEFORE ANY ZERO-SHOT SCORE OF THIS ARM EXISTS
motivation: The Mechanism-v2 grid froze a LINEAR paired ranker. The leaky capacity diagnostic (results/mechanism_v3/diagnostics/ceiling_analysis.json) shows a nonlinear model on the same features recovers +0.0218 rank gain versus +0.0025 for the linear model in the same leaky setting. Model class, not feature choice, is the largest untested lever.

estimator.note: regression on the training partition's outcomes only; scored fold never seen

features: all available blocks: geometry, rbp_delta, bert_pooled_delta, structure_delta, processing_delta, motif_delta, trans_aligned, plus the frozen random_kmer control block (1146 columns)
baseline: geometry-only model of the identical estimator family and hyperparameters, so the comparison isolates features and not model class
splits: the committed all-allele 95% connected components and five outer folds from results/mechanism_v2/manifests/splits_all_alleles95.json; whole components are held out, so no evaluation parent is ever in training
zero_shot_contract: for each outer fold, fit on every candidate row with outer_fold != k and score fold k exactly once; concatenate the five folds for full coverage
multiplicity: This is arm 2 of the Mechanism-v3 family (arm 1 = outcome-free zipcode grammar). Holm correction is applied across the family when any positive claim is made.
stopping_rule: Mechanism-v3 closes after this arm. No further arms may be added in response to this arm's result; adding arms until one passes would be fishing and is forbidden.
honest_prior: The leaky ceiling for this exact estimator is +0.0218 rank gain, only 0.0018 above the g1 minimum, and that ceiling is measured WITH same-parent leakage that the zero-shot contract forbids. The pre-registered expectation is therefore failure.
